case.rationale: The task represents a realistic administrative workflow where an assistant fetches an email, retrieves an attachment from it, and performs a specific CRM cleanup by archiving an outdated company record.

arguments.query: Please review the latest vendor email regarding our contract renewal, download the attached agreement document for my records, and then clean up our HubSpot CRM by archiving the outdated company profile associated with their old subsidiary ID.

results.use_case: Please review the latest vendor email regarding our contract renewal, download the attached agreement document for my records, and then clean up our HubSpot CRM by archiving the outdated company profile associated with their old subsidiary ID.
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite (if company_id provided)]: Verify the target record using HUBSPOT_GET_COMPANY (confirm name/domain/keys match intended company).
[Optional (if company_id unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Find matching companyId(s) using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_COMPANIES or browse candidates via HUBSPOT_LIST_COMPANIES (review before deletion).
[Required (after explicit user confirmation)] [Step]: Archive the company using HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_COMPANY (soft-delete by company_id).
[Optional (if HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_COMPANY fails or generic path needed)] [Fallback]: Archive using HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_CRM_OBJECT_BY_ID (archive the company record by ID).
[Optional (if archiving multiple known IDs)] [Step]: Archive in bulk using HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_COMPANIES (provide inputs[].id; batch large sets as needed).
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_COMPANY] Archives (soft-delete) only; irreversible GDPR-style permanent deletion is not covered by the allowed tool set—confirm compliance requirements before proceeding.
[HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_COMPANY] Archiving can change how related objects/reporting behave even if associations remain—confirm downstream impact.
[HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_COMPANIES] Expects list payload with inputs[].id; validate IDs carefully to avoid accidental deletions.
[HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_COMPANIES] Large ID sets should be batched/paced; hundreds of archives (e.g., 200+ IDs) may require limited parallelism.
[HUBSPOT_LIST_COMPANIES] limit must be <= 100 (validation error observed when requesting a larger limit).

HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_COMPANY.description: Archives an existing company in HubSpot CRM by its `companyId`, moving it to a recycling bin from which it can be restored, rather than permanently deleting it.

companyId.description: The numeric identifier for the company to archive. Must contain only digits (e.g., '1234567890'). Do not use email addresses or other non-numeric identifiers.

HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_COMPANIES.description: Archives multiple HubSpot companies by their IDs.

id.description: The unique identifier of the company to be archived.

items.description: Request schema for individual company archive operation.

inputs.description: A list of company objects, each specifying the ID of the company to be archived.

HUBSPOT_GET_COMPANY.description: Retrieves a HubSpot company by its ID.

archived.description: Set to true to include only archived companies; defaults to false (active companies).

companyId.description: Unique HubSpot identifier for the company to retrieve.

properties.description: Company property names to include in the response; if omitted, only default properties (name, domain, createdate, etc.) are returned. Use "all" to retrieve all properties, or specify individual property names. Accepts a list of strings or a JSON-stringified array (e.g., '["name", "domain"]').

associations.description: Object types (e.g., 'contacts', 'deals') to include associated object IDs in the response. Accepts a list of strings or a JSON-stringified array (e.g., '["contacts", "deals"]').

propertiesWithHistory.description: Property names for which to include current and historical values in the response. Accepts a list of strings or a JSON-stringified array.

HUBSPOT_SEARCH_COMPANIES.description: Searches for HubSpot companies using flexible criteria and filters.
